cause: The transformed detail drawer traps its tooltip below the separate pull-tab layer. Labels also conflicted when keyboard focus and hover were on different tiles.
fix: Position labels 5px above the pull tab, align outer labels to logical tile edges, and give keyboard focus priority over a different hovered tile.
scope: CSS-only web and installed web fix. Native Android has no floating labels. Drawer motion, input masking, level selection, prompts, model and credits are unchanged.

verification.red: Both overlap and simultaneous hover/focus regressions failed before their corresponding fixes.
verification.unitTests: 615 passed, one opt-in paid-generation test skipped
verification.browserTests: 31 production-built browser cases passed initially. After the hover/focus follow-up, all eight selector cases passed, including the new regression.
verification.coverage: All ten languages at 320, 390 and 1280 CSS pixels, all three hovered labels, keyboard focus, Escape, reopening, screen edges, mobile and installed shell, RTL, persistence and input masking.
verification.visualReview: Rendered English 320px, Arabic 390px and Dutch desktop fixtures, plus final real production desktop screenshot.
verification.live: Medium label visible, other labels hidden, 5px clearance above pull tab, no horizontal overflow. Escape dismisses drawer and restores toggle focus. Drawer reopens successfully.
verification.spending: No generation requests or image-provider spending. Credits remained 98.
verification.review: Scoped review performed inline, with no independent review claimed.

deploymentNote: The first upload returned Not authorized. Existing account membership and project access were verified. The retry succeeded without credential or permission changes.
